notes.title: Another Gamescom, another demo update 🐷💀🖤
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]
We're thrilled to announce that Spindle will be playable again at Gamescom this year! 
[b]From August 20 to 24, visit Kim & Tom in Hall 10.2 at the Deck13 Spotlight Indie Arena Booth[/b] 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40899870/8a7d1d7ae161d3255354c1fedac7e73823124ac9.png[/img]
[h3]Some familiar sights, but so much more to explore[/h3]
To celebrate this occasion, [b]we're adding a bunch of new content to previous versions of the demo.[/b] This update really highlights how far we've come in terms of the level of detail and the attention we've put into every little interaction in our world.

[b]Experience the beginning of the game, including the never-before-seen intro,[/b] and explore how the first area of Spindle changes after defeating the dungeon boss. This gives you a much better idea of what the final game will feel like, with lots of fun details to discover 🐣

[h3]Let us know what you think[/h3]
If you're also attending Gamescom, be sure to stop by and chat! Otherwise, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3Qr4B3TqN5]Discord server[/url] and tell us your thoughts on the update there! 

The finish line draws near, so please enjoy the demo and [b]stay tuned for more information soon[/b] (especially regarding the exact release date 👀)! 
And as always, thank you for your ongoing support, we were so happy to see how excited people were about last week's trailer 💌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1386750/Spindle/

notes.title: Spindle Developer Stream & Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Just so that you know, due to our english skills the video is pre-recorded. But nevertheless you will learn a lot about Spindle, how it all started and what the motivations are.

Also, a new update for the demo is available!

[b]Spindle Changelog v1.2.0[/b]
- New underground areas
- Pig can now go down into holes
- New lumberjack side Quest
- Nicer coin reward at skeleton
- bug fixes (probably)

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
Finally, the first update for the Demo is out now! And we even added a few minor features and fixed a few bugs!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] After 30 seconds you can pet the pig!
[*] Improved the basement of the mill
[*] Coins now have 1, 4 and 10-Steps
[*] Fixed multiple transition bugs
[*] Improved the analog stick controls
[*]Title Screen has a small Kickstarter Info
[/list]
